verbatim_text.title: Most Common Kernel Functions
body: γ is called RBF Kernel bandwidth
bullets: Linear Kernel: K(a,b)=a^T b; No Mapping , φ(x)=x
Quadratic Kernel: K(a,b)=[a^T b]^2 or K(a,b)=[a^T b + 1]^2
Polynomial Kernel (of degree “d”): K(a,b)=[a^T b]^d or K(a,b)=[a^T b + 1]^d
Radial Basis Function (RBF) Kernel: K(a,b)=[e^(−γ(a−b)^2)]; γ is called RBF Kernel bandwidth
